final:
I could not leave #general. The Slack API returned `cant_leave_general` when I called `conversations.leave` on the channel (C_GEN), and `cant_kick_self` when I tried to remove myself via `conversations.kick`.

#general is a protected default channel in Slack — users cannot leave it by design. The only way to remove a member would be for an admin/another user to run `conversations.kick` on them, which I cannot do to myself. So this task is blocked by a platform restriction, not a credentials or permission issue (the channel was correctly identified and my membership confirmed).
